verdict.rationale: Custom dashboards are documented only by exporting to PostHog, an external tool. Natively, Helicone offers HQL/SQL querying over its ClickHouse store, built-in charts that users mention, and alerts on error rates and costs, which supply raw latency/error/cost data but not a dashboard builder. Missing for 10: a native custom dashboard builder, explicit latency and eval-score widgets or dashboards, documentation of how HQL feeds visualizations, and independent hands-on corroboration of dashboard customization.
